_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Additive extension of the already-landed VatCorrection register with the fields VatSuppletieDetectionService needs to persist a filed/current rubriek snapshot, per-rubriek deltas, the suppletie-threshold decision, the 8-week filing deadline, and a link to the compiled GL correction posting. audit coverage is already satisfied for VatCorrection/VatReturn by add-shillinq-audit-trail.json's x-openregister-audit-trail.enabled flag — not touched here. Merged additively onto the monolith per ADR-037 — no existing field, state, or transition is touched.

filedSnapshot.description: As-filed per-rubriek totals (audit trail of the original filed figures), captured from the VATDeclaration rows persisted at filing time. Populated by VatSuppletieDetectionService:detect.

type.title: Rubriek Type
type.description: Which side of the BTW return this bucket belongs to: collected = verschuldigde omzetbelasting (output VAT), paid = voorbelasting (input VAT), reverse-charge = verlegde BTW.

taxRate.title: Tax Rate
taxRate.description: BTW rate of this bucket as a percentage (21, 9 or 0), not a decimal fraction.

totalVATAmount.title: Total VAT Amount
totalVATAmount.description: VAT amount filed for this bucket, in EUR.

totalTaxableAmount.title: Total Taxable Amount
totalTaxableAmount.description: Taxable base (omzet excluding VAT) filed for this bucket, in EUR.

filedSnapshot.title: Filed Snapshot

currentSnapshot.description: Per-rubriek totals recomputed live from GL at detection time, in the same shape as filedSnapshot. Populated by VatSuppletieDetectionService:detect.

type.title: Rubriek Type
type.description: Which side of the BTW return this bucket belongs to: collected = verschuldigde omzetbelasting (output VAT), paid = voorbelasting (input VAT), reverse-charge = verlegde BTW.

taxRate.title: Tax Rate
taxRate.description: BTW rate of this bucket as a percentage (21, 9 or 0), not a decimal fraction.

totalVATAmount.title: Total VAT Amount
totalVATAmount.description: VAT amount for this bucket as recomputed from the general ledger now, in EUR.

totalTaxableAmount.title: Total Taxable Amount
totalTaxableAmount.description: Taxable base (omzet excluding VAT) for this bucket as recomputed from the general ledger now, in EUR.

currentSnapshot.title: Current Snapshot

categoryDeltas.description: Per-rubriek delta (currentSnapshot minus filedSnapshot) for every bucket with a non-zero difference. Populated by VatSuppletieDetectionService:prepare.

type.title: Rubriek Type
type.description: Which side of the BTW return this delta belongs to: collected = verschuldigde omzetbelasting (output VAT), paid = voorbelasting (input VAT), reverse-charge = verlegde BTW.

taxRate.title: Tax Rate
taxRate.description: BTW rate of the bucket this delta applies to, as a percentage (21, 9 or 0).

deltaVATAmount.title: Delta VAT Amount
deltaVATAmount.description: currentSnapshot minus filedSnapshot for this bucket's VAT amount, in EUR. Positive means additional VAT is owed; negative means a refund is due.

deltaTaxableAmount.title: Delta Taxable Amount
deltaTaxableAmount.description: currentSnapshot minus filedSnapshot for this bucket's taxable base, in EUR.

glAccountNumber.title: GL Account Number
glAccountNumber.description: Account the original rubriek posted to; reused for the GL correction line.

categoryDeltas.title: Rubriek Deltas

detectedAt.description: Timestamp VatSuppletieDetectionService:detect created this record (the 'detected' sub-state —).
detectedAt.title: Detected At

preparedAt.description: Timestamp VatSuppletieDetectionService:prepare finished compiling deltas + the GL posting (the 'prepared' sub-state — record is draft but operator-reviewable and ready to file).
preparedAt.title: Prepared At

thresholdExceeded.description: True when abs(correctionAmount) >= the statutory €1.000 suppletie grens (verified against belastingdienst.nl); operator still decides whether to file.
thresholdExceeded.title: Threshold Exceeded

filingDeadline.description: preparedAt + 8 weeks — the statutory suppletie filing deadline once a threshold-exceeding correction is discovered.
filingDeadline.title: Filing Deadline

glCorrectionTransactionId.description: FK to the draft GLTransaction booking this correction's delta, compiled by VatSuppletieDetectionService:prepare. Never auto-posted.
glCorrectionTransactionId.title: GL Correction Transaction ID
